## Books Recommended by Jennifer for Fitness Nutrition

- **"The New Rules of Lifting"** by Lou Schuler and Alwyn Cosgrove
  - *Description*: This book provides a holistic approach to fitness by merging nutritional advice with workout regimens. It is designed to help readers optimize their health and performance through informed dietary choices.

- **"Precision Nutrition"**
  - *Description*: A resource offering online courses, "Precision Nutrition" is an excellent platform for individuals who wish to delve into fitness nutrition with structured learning. It focuses on evidence-based nutrition principles tailored to individual needs.
